CRM.rationale: Salesforce presents a compelling fundamental picture with accelerating revenue growth (+13.3% YoY to $11.13B in Q1 FY27), strong EPS expansion (+52.2% YoY to $2.42), and robust operating cash flow ($6.70B). The company maintains dominant CRM market share (20%, #1 for 13 consecutive years per IDC) and is successfully monetizing AI through Agentforce ($1.2B ARR, +205% YoY). Gross margins remain excellent at 77.6% and net margins have expanded to 18.7%. However, the balance sheet has deteriorated significantly with debt rising from $8.44B to $39.28B (D/E of 1.15) to fund the massive $25B accelerated share repurchase, and total equity declined from $61.33B to $34.23B. Valuation is attractive vs. own history: the P/E of 18.07 is at the absolute bottom of its 365-day range (18.1-57.4), representing a dramatic compression from 56x a year ago. The stock is down ~37% from its highs. The $27B buyback in Q1 and $50B authorization signal management conviction. Near-term catalysts include continued Agentforce adoption momentum and the Anthropic IPO (Salesforce holds a $5B stake). Risks include rising interest rates (10Y at 4.45%), macro uncertainty, and the debt-funded buyback strategy. The combination of strong growth acceleration, dominant market position, historically cheap valuation, and clear AI monetization path supports a moderately positive view, tempered by balance sheet leverage and macro headwinds.
